frac_clique_minor.note: frac_clique_minor B w r: a feasible point of the fractional clique-minor LP of G with value r: non-negative weights on an indexed family of branch sets, each NON-EMPTY and connected, pairwise adjacent for distinct indices, every vertex covered by total weight at most 1, r the total weight (branch sets need not be disjoint). This is the body repaired in wave E10; the pre-repair body (possibly empty branch sets) had an unbounded LP and is kept only as a historical record in grounding_D2chr.

is_fractional_hadwiger.note: is_fractional_hadwiger G r: r is the attained maximum of the clique-minor LP, the standard fractional Hadwiger number of a finite graph as a relation; the value is unique, lies in [0, #|G|], and exists for every finite graph (LP attainment, Atlas.foundations.fractional.frac_hadwiger_exists). No guard on G: the empty graph has value 0.
